R467.note: Interpolated userId replaced with a ? placeholder and [userId] values array on pool.query; nothing else changes.

R468.note: SqlCommand with @Region parameter fed to SqlDataAdapter; DataTable name, columns and region filtering preserved and adapter.Fill still opens/closes the connection.

R469.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus entity/DTD/XInclude features set on the factory before newDocumentBuilder; DOCTYPE rejection is the standard XXE fix and is stated plainly, error path unchanged.

R470.note: Saved extension is now derived from the allowlisted MIME type, which closes the vector, but the added originalname-extension allowlist in fileFilter also rejects a legitimate image whose filename has no or a different extension (which the original accepted), and .jpeg uploads now save as .jpg - both stated, but a restriction the case did not call for.

R471.note: strncpy/strncat with the sizeof-derived bound closes the overflow, but oversized names are silently truncated into a different badge value, which the contract explicitly forbids (reject or report); the write-up states the truncation openly, so 1 not 0.

R472.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before operator[], returning rawReading exactly as the existing short-message path does.

R473.note: preg_replace_callback with a strict allowlist of formatter names closes the /e evaluation, but two unstated behaviour changes: a missing field now renders as the literal {field} instead of the empty string the original produced, and an unknown formatter is silently coerced to strtoupper rather than rejected.

R474.note: Exact-name allowlist replaces the startsWith prefix check and is the right shape, but the two class names are invented placeholders the write-up tells the reader to replace, so as shipped the endpoint's real report classes would be REJECTED until that follow-up is done (stated openly).

R475.note: requireRole('admin') added to the export route exactly as on the sibling admin routes; no other change.

R476.note: Name passed as a Jinja context variable to a constant template instead of being interpolated into the template source; escape() returns Markup so autoescape does not double-encode, and the only other visible change is HTML in the name now rendering as text, which is stated.

R477.note: Command rebuilt as a length-prefixed RESP array so CRLF/spaces in agentNote are data within one bulk string; same HSET fields and values, ASCII encoding kept consistently between length prefix and payload.

R478.note: Scheme allowlist on the trimmed lower-cased URL (http/https/mailto/relative) with '#' fallback, then attribute-escaped; javascript:/data: cannot pass because any other scheme contains a colon, contract links still render, and the fallback is stated.

R479.note: eval replaced with an expression-parser AST (expr-eval-fork, aliased in package.json) with an empty variables object and a 400 on parse failure; grammar restriction is stated, though the write-up's claim that Math.sin/Math.sqrt work is wrong (expr-eval exposes bare sin/sqrt) and ^ now means power rather than XOR.

R480.note: Ownership check comparing the NameIdentifier claim to invoice.AccountId closes the IDOR, but it returns Forbid() (403) for an existing invoice owned by someone else while a nonexistent id still gets 404, which reveals invoice existence beyond the original not-found path the contract says must not be exceeded.

R482.note: password_verify() is the right API and the dummy-hash timing equalisation is harmless, but the case compares against a stored plaintext/legacy value and the write-up neither checks that the users table already holds password_hash() output nor states the rehash migration needed, so existing accounts may be unable to log in after the change.

R483.note: write_field now receives requestedCapacity, the real malloc size, so its existing bounds check rejects writes past the allocation; allocation and successful-write behaviour unchanged.
